source_title: An InventHelp 123Invent Client Develops Safety Assistance Idea for Boat Loading (KSG-320)
source_excerpt:
PITTSBURGH , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- "I wanted to help reduce the risk of property damage and personal injury at boat ramps," said an inventor from Slocomb, Ala. "My idea would help boat operators better align with a trailer so loading could be safer, easier and less stressful."
InventHelp Invention Spotlight: ACCULOAD Could Help Reduce Boat Loading Problems at Ramps
Provides added guidance when loading a boat onto a trailer
Helps reduce the risk of boat, trailer and property damage
Promotes safer operation and fewer stressful loading situations InventHelp Client's Invention for Boaters
Loading a boat onto a trailer can be difficult due to poor visibility, changing water conditions and alignment challenges, which could increase the risk of damage or injury. The ACCULOAD idea would offer a marine assistance system that could help boaters complete the loading process with greater confidence.
Licensing Opportunities for InventHelp 123Invent Client:
The invention is available for licensing or sale to manufacturers or marketers who may wish to bring it to market.
For more information, visit www.accuload.net . Or contact Willie Long at (334) 737-9611 or email [email protected] .
